body: An MLOps framework to package, deploy, monitor and manage thousands of production machine learning models
plain_description: **Deploy and scale AI applications across your Kubernetes environments.** Serve multiple models together to reduce infrastructure costs. Route traffic between models or pipelines for A/B tests and shadow deployments.
technical_description: Seldon Core 2 is an MLOps and LLMOps framework for deploying, managing, and scaling AI systems in Kubernetes, on premises or in the cloud. It supports model serving, composable AI pipelines with Kafka streaming, autoscaling, multi-model serving, overcommit, and experiments that route data between candidate models or pipelines.
title: Seldon Core 2
